headline: European Stocks Rise as Oil Slips on Iran De-Escalation Hopes
summary: European equities climbed at the close of trade, supported by declining oil prices driven by hopes of de-escalation regarding Iran.
why: Lower crude oil prices ease input cost pressures for industrial economies and temper central bank inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Slumping oil prices reduce near-term revenue expectations for major petroleum producers.

why_moved: Easing geopolitical tensions surrounding Iran drove oil futures lower, reducing inflation fears and boosting broader equity market sentiment.
